create_demo_mm_inputs: create fake detection inputs with random bboxes, labels, and masks for testing object detectors
create_demo_track_inputs: create fake tracking inputs with random bboxes and instance IDs for video object tracking tests
create_demo_sampling_results: create sampling results from proposals and ground truth instances for bbox head target assignment
get_detector_cfg: get a deep copied detector model config from a config file for safe parameter modification
create_random_boxes: create random bounding boxes in x1, y1, x2, y2 format with a given scale and count
